ClaimStatement: If a ballot is shown as RECORDED, the client holds an inclusion proof against a quorum-cosigned checkpoint.
Notes: Core invariant from doc 150.

ClaimStatement: A dishonest log operator cannot equivocate (split-world) without producing fork evidence detectable by independent witnesses.
ENR / results pipeline publishes content-addressed evidence bundles suitable for independent verification and dispute resolution.
Election Parameter Bundle (EPB) is signed, logged, and non-equivocating; clients/verifiers reject unsigned or stale parameters.
Notes: EPB is the root of public meaning.

ClaimStatement: Parameter publication meets an MMD-style deadline; missed deadlines yield a signed suppression/outage object.
Notes: Time-bounded accountability.

ClaimStatement: Witness quorum policy prevents a single operator from producing final checkpoints without independent cosigners.
Cross-checkpoint gossip detects split-view checkpoints across audiences within the gossip horizon.
Election Night Reporting (ENR) outputs are content-addressed and reproducible from public evidence bundles.
TestOrDrillLane: Repro build drill: ENR from evidence

ClaimStatement: Audience parity monitoring detects if different audiences receive different ENR or status artifacts.
Ballot definitions are integrity-checked end-to-end; published hashes bind UI to ballots; canaries detect targeted manipulation.
Dispute resolution uses signed, time-stamped evidence bundles with clear chain-of-custody and retention policy.
Availability evidence pipeline produces corroborated unreachability proofs (URPs) suitable for public scrutiny.
Independent notarization/timestamping anchors key artifacts so backdating/rewriting is detectable.
No long-term citizen credential directly signs ballots; credentials only mint unlinkable eligibility tokens.
Notes: Core invariant; applies broadly.

ClaimStatement: Eligibility token issuance is auditable without revealing voter choices or enabling coercion proofs.
Submission layer provides anonymity properties (OHTTP/ODoH optional) and resists traffic-analysis at stated bounds.
Notes: Bounds must be explicit.

ClaimStatement: Anti-abuse controls rate-limit without durable identity linkage and publish evidence of policy and exceptions.
Coercion-resistance mitigations are stated precisely; claims do not exceed evidence; risks are explicit.
Notes: Annex must stay honest.

ClaimStatement: Key management and rotations are transparent, with revocation and compromise recovery producing public proof artifacts.
Build and supply-chain integrity for verifiers is attested; reproducible builds or equivalent evidence exists for released verifier binaries.
Device attestation evidence (EAT profile) binds the voting device state to reference values and endorsements that are publicly auditable.
Reference values and endorsements are published via a split-world-resistant transparency mechanism; inconsistent views become provable.
Manufacturing pipeline produces chained, signed statements for critical steps (in-toto style), enabling independent provenance audits.
Public verification bundles can be built offline and independently validate key claims without privileged access.
Change control ensures security-relevant decisions are captured as ADRs with consequences and follow-ups; major scope changes are explicit.
Notes: TriKEM-style survivability.

ClaimStatement: Public inspection challenges are sampled deterministically from a public randomness seed under a published schedule and quota policy, making challenge grinding auditable.
Notes: Hardens the verification ecosystem against friendly-challenge selection.

ClaimStatement: Missed inspection deadlines produce signed suppression reports that can be mirrored and gossiped, making selective non-response provable.
Notes: Turns 'they ignored us' into a portable, verifiable artifact.

ClaimStatement: Monitor outputs (coverage reports, challenge logs, and suppression reports) are themselves auditable, enabling watchers to detect selective blindness and misconfiguration.
TestOrDrillLane: Quarterly audit: monitor behavior vs policy
Notes: Watchers inspecting monitors as a deliverable, not an aspiration.

ClaimStatement: Critical election software (firmware, verifiers, results/reporting stack) is shipped with verifiable build provenance (SLSA/in-toto) bound to artifacts, enabling reproducibility and forensic audit.
ThreatsAddressed: software supply-chain compromise; verifier/toolchain capture; silent backdoors
TestOrDrillLane: Build provenance verification drill (reproducibility + signature checks)
Notes: Use SLSA provenance v1 in in-toto statements; anchor distribution via transparency service where possible.

ClaimStatement: For each election, a public, content-addressed evidence packet exists (manifest + objects) enabling offline integrity verification and durable mirroring.
ThreatsAddressed: evidence spoliation; selective disclosure; archive drift
Notes: This is about survivable evidence, not just publishing a webpage.

ClaimStatement: Monitors/watchers publish signed coverage accounting (targets, perspectives, time) so verification ecosystem representativeness is measurable and auditable.
ThreatsAddressed: monitor capture; challenge grinding; selective blindness
Notes: Start simple; improve metrics as the ecosystem matures.

ClaimStatement: Endorsement and reference-value updates are transparently logged, gossiped, and revocable, making split-view/capture attempts provable and recoverable.
ThreatsAddressed: registry split-view; endorsement laundering; revocation suppression
TestOrDrillLane: Interop audit: receipt + gossip + revocation drill
Notes: Conditional on North Star governance assumptions.

ClaimStatement: EvidenceEnvelopes use deterministic canonicalization (RFC8785-JCS) so independent verifiers compute identical payload_digest and bytes-to-sign (tbs_digest).
ThreatsAddressed: format drift / selective disclosure / fake artifacts
Notes: Keep payloads I-JSON; prefer string IDs.

ClaimStatement: A public evidence packet can be verified offline from a directory of files using only content-addressing and envelope digest binding (signature verification optional but supported by the signing rules).
ThreatsAddressed: selective disclosure / mirror corruption / long-tail disputes
Notes: Example packet is minimal; add receipts for stronger anti-split-view proofs.

ClaimStatement: Core public evidence artifacts are receipted by a transparency service and gossiped across perspectives using standardized attachments, making selective disclosure detectable.
ThreatsAddressed: selective disclosure; split-view targeting; suppression laundering
Notes: Treat receipts and gossip as first-class deliverables; avoid assuming a single global auditor.

ClaimStatement: Evidence publication deadlines are governed by a published PublicationContract; missed deadlines yield signed PublicationSuppressionReports that can be mirrored and gossiped.
ThreatsAddressed: selective delay; evidence suppression; split-view targeting
TestOrDrillLane: Drill: deadline breach + publish suppression report + gossip compare
Notes: Treat 'missingness' as a portable object; improves dispute posture and anti-capture resilience.

ClaimStatement: Public communications during election operations (status/incident/corrections) are published as content-addressed PublicNotices with receipts + gossip attachments, making selective omission and later dispute provable.
ThreatsAddressed: disinfo; rumor control failure; selective disclosure; narrative capture
TestOrDrillLane: Drill: incident comms + correction + mirror compare
Notes: Treat comms as an engineering surface: publish verifiable notices linked to evidence packets.

ClaimStatement: Publication compliance is measurable from receipted+gossiped TriggerEvents and a PublicationContract, producing PublicationCoverageReports that quantify selective delay/omission (including public notice suppression).
ThreatsAddressed: selective delay; selective omission; narrative suppression; split-view targeting
TestOrDrillLane: Drill: trigger events + publish evidence + compute coverage + compare across watchers
Notes: This is intentionally simple in v0; future work can strengthen linkage requirements.

ClaimStatement: Publishable verifier packet reports pin and publish the evaluated policy profile so decisions are comparable across verifiers.
ThreatsAddressed: policy drift; report ambiguity; unverifiable verifier decisions
Notes: Keep the policy profile compact and cite it by digest.
